seoTitle: MRR and ARR Calculator With Net New MRR
metaDescription: Compute MRR and ARR from plan prices and subscribers, and net new MRR from new, expansion, contraction and churned revenue.
intro: Calculates monthly and annual recurring revenue and the monthly movement of MRR.
why:
MRR is the sum of recurring monthly revenue and ARR is twelve times that. The useful view is the movement: new plus expansion minus contraction minus churn gives net new MRR and a growth rate.

List plans as name, price, subscribers, then enter the movement components. Define MRR the way your investors do, usually excluding one-off fees and uncertain usage.
howTo: List plans with price and subscribers.
Enter new, expansion, contraction and churned MRR.

faq.a: Recurring subscription revenue only, normalised to a month.
Yes, as a run rate, not a forecast.
